task_description: Write a method in Dafny to reverse only the vowels of a given string (where y is not a vowel).
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ReverseVowels(s: string) returns (v: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The length of the returning string must be the same as the length of the input string
- The vowels in the string are reversed in position, while all other characters remain in their original positions
- All non-vowel characters are unchanged from the input string
- The set of vowels in the output string corresponds to the set of vowels in the input string, just reversed in order
